title: Goodman-type lower bounds for graph homomorphism densities
summary: For a finite graph $H$ with $v(H)$ vertices, chromatic number $χ(H)$, and chromatic polynomial $P_H$, define $Φ_H(p)=(1-p)^{v(H)}P_H((1-p)^{-1})$. This polynomial interpolates the homomorphism densities of $H$ in balanced complete multipartite graphons. We study the lower bound $t(H,W)\geΦ_H(p)$ on the homomorphism density of $H$ in graphons $W$ of edge density $p>1-1/(χ(H)-1)$, which generalises Goodman's triangle bound. We prove the inequality for chordal graphs whose maximal cliques have equal size, for trivially perfect graphs, and for joins of a clique and an odd cycle. The proofs use entropy along clique trees and a convexity criterion for adding a universal vertex. We also prove that a nonbipartite graph satisfies the inequality at all sufficiently high edge densities if and only if its girth is odd. For a graph on $n$ vertices whose girth is odd, the bound holds whenever $p>1-(72n^{12})^{-1}$. The proof combines Whitney's forest expansion with a spectral comparison of cycle densities. Finally, among the $117$ nonbipartite graphs on at most six vertices with no isolated vertices or isolated edges, exactly $94$ satisfy the bound. The main results are formally verified in Lean 4.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了图同态密度 $t(H,W)$ 在边密度 $p$ 下的下界 $\Phi_H(p)$，证明了该不等式对若干图类成立，并给出了非二部图满足该界的充要条件，部分结果在 Lean 4 中形式化验证。
AI.motivation: Goodman 的三角形下界是极值图论中的经典结果，本文将其推广到一般图 $H$ 的同态密度，旨在刻画哪些图 $H$ 在给定边密度下能由 $\Phi_H(p)$ 给出紧的下界，这有助于理解图极限中的密度不等式和广义 Goodman 型问题。
AI.method: 主要技术包括沿 clique tree 的熵方法、添加 universal vertex 的凸性准则、Whitney 的森林展开以及 cycle densities 的谱比较，并使用了 Lean 4 进行形式化验证。
AI.result: 对于最大团等大的 chordal graphs、trivially perfect graphs 以及一个团与奇圈的 join，证明了 $t(H,W) \ge \Phi_H(p)$ 在 $p>1-1/(\chi(H)-1)$ 时成立；非二部图 $H$ 在所有充分高的边密度下满足该不等式当且仅当其围长（girth）为奇数；若 $H$ 有 $n$ 个顶点且围长为奇数，则当 $p>1-(72n^{12})^{-1}$ 时不等式成立；在至多六个顶点且无孤立点或孤立边的 117 个非二部图中，恰有 94 个满足该界。
AI.conclusion: 本文推广了 Goodman 的三角形下界，揭示了围长奇偶性对密度不等式成立性的关键影响，并为相关图类提供了统一处理框架，形式化验证增强了结果的可靠性。
AI.future_work: 论文未明确列出 open problems，但自然的问题是确定 $\Phi_H(p)$ 成立的精确阈值，刻画更多图类（如一般非二部图）的成立条件，并探索形式化方法在极值图论中的进一步应用。

title: Upper bounds for the number of spanning forests of a graph
summary: Let $G$ be a simple graph on $n$ vertices, and let $F(G)$ denote the number of spanning forests of $G$. Bencs and Csikvári proved that every $r$-regular graph $G$ with $r\ge 2$ satisfies $F(G)\le r^n$. Motivated by this result, they conjectured that if $G$ has minimum degree at least $3$, then $F(G)\leq \prod_{i=1}^n d_i$, where $(d_1, d_2, \dots, d_n)$ is the degree sequence of $G$. In this paper, we prove that graphs with minimum degree at least $n/3$ $(n\geq7)$ satisfy $F(G)\leq \prod_{i=1}^n d_i$. We also construct a counterexample to the conjecture. We therefore further study the enumeration of spanning forests in general graphs, proving an upper bound in terms of the degree sequence and characterizing the extremal graphs attaining this bound. In addition, using the matrix-forest theorem, we obtain an upper bound for the number of spanning forests of a connected graph in terms of its algebraic connectivity, and characterize the extremal graphs attaining this bound.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了图的生成森林数量 $F(G)$ 的上界，证明了最小度至少为 $n/3$ 的图满足 Bencs-Csikvári 猜想，并构造了反例，进而给出了基于度序列和代数连通度的上界及极图刻画。
AI.motivation: Bencs 和 Csikvári 证明了 $r$-正则图满足 $F(G)\le r^n$，并猜想最小度至少为 3 的图满足 $F(G)\le \prod_{i=1}^n d_i$。该猜想将生成森林计数与度序列联系起来，是矩阵树定理和生成树计数研究的重要延伸。
AI.method: 主要使用了矩阵-森林定理（matrix-forest theorem）将生成森林数量与拉普拉斯矩阵的特征值联系起来，并结合度序列分析和极值图论中的刻画方法。
AI.result: 证明了最小度至少为 $n/3$（$n\geq7$）的图满足 $F(G)\le \prod_{i=1}^n d_i$；构造了反例推翻原猜想；进一步证明了基于度序列的一般上界并刻画了极图；利用矩阵-森林定理得到了基于代数连通度的连通图上界并刻画了极图。
AI.conclusion: 结果部分解决了 Bencs-Csikvári 猜想，表明该猜想在最小度较大时成立但一般情况不成立，同时提供了生成森林计数的新的上界工具。
AI.future_work: 论文未明确列出开放问题，但自然的问题是确定猜想成立的最小度阈值，以及改进基于代数连通度的上界并研究其他图参数的影响。

title: From Diagonal Coloring to Proper Vertex Labelings Distinguishing Adjacent Facial Sums
summary: In this paper we study proper vertex labelings of 3-connected plane graphs that give distinct boundary-vertex sums to faces sharing an edge. Let $λ(G)$ be the least $k$ for which labels from $\{0,\ldots,k\}$ suffice, and let $\laml(G)$ be its arbitrary-real-list counterpart. Our two main results are an eight-element list theorem for fullerenes and the universal bound $λ(G)\le708587$ for all 3-connected plane graphs. We establish structural nine- and eight-color bounds, classify triangulations whose vertices of degree at least five form an independent set, and determine their exact diagonal chromatic numbers. We also prove closure under triangular sums for $q\ge7$ diagonal colors, with an optimal uniform threshold. For cubic 3-connected plane graphs we obtain $λ\le14$, improving to $λ\le9$ in the bipartite case.

AI.tldr: 本文研究 3-连通平面图的 proper vertex labeling，使得共享一条边的两个面具有不同的边界顶点标号和，证明了 fullerenes 的八元列表定理以及所有 3-连通平面图的通用上界 $\lambda(G)\le708587$。
AI.motivation: 该问题源于对角着色（diagonal coloring）与可区分相邻面边界和的顶点标号，是图着色与平面图结构交叉的自然问题；此前缺乏对一般 3-连通平面图的有限上界，也缺少对 fullerenes 等特殊图类的列表版本结果。
AI.method: 结合结构分析（对度数至少为 5 的顶点构成独立集的三角剖分进行分类）、对角着色与 triangular sums 的闭合性论证，以及列表着色的 absorption/extension 技巧，建立九色与八色结构界。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：fullerenes 的八元列表定理；对所有 3-连通平面图 $\lambda(G)\le708587$；对 $q\ge7$ 个对角颜色证明 triangular sums 下的闭合性并给出最优统一阈值；对立方 3-连通平面图得到 $\lambda\le14$，二部情形改进为 $\lambda\le9$。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次给出一般 3-连通平面图的有限通用上界，并精确确定了一类三角剖分的对角色数，将 diagonal coloring 与可区分相邻面边界和的顶点标号联系起来；但上界 $708587$ 与下界之间仍有巨大差距。
AI.future_work: 论文未明确列出 open problems；自然的后续方向是大幅改进一般 3-连通平面图的上界 $\lambda(G)\le708587$，研究 $\laml(G)$ 的列表版本一般上界，并探索 fullerenes 八元列表定理的紧性。

title: Efficient Reconfiguration of Independent Transversals
summary: We study the reconfiguration of independent transversals in graphs with a prescribed vertex partition. Given a graph $G$ with a vertex partition $\mathcal{V}=(V_1,\ldots,V_m)$, an independent transversal is an independent set containing exactly one vertex from each part $V_i$ of $\mathcal{V}$. The reconfiguration problem concerns transforming one independent transversal into another through a sequence of local changes, while preserving the independent transversal property at every step. For any fixed $r\in\mathbb{N}$ and $ε>0$, we present a polynomial-time algorithm that, given an $r$-claw-free graph $G$ with a vertex partition $\mathcal{V}=(V_1,\ldots,V_m)$ and two independent transversals $S$ and $R$, either finds a polynomial-length reconfiguration path between $S$ and $R$, or identifies a nonempty set of partition classes $\mathcal{B}\subseteq\mathcal{V}$ such that the subgraph induced by their union admits a strong dominating set of size at most $(2+ε)|\mathcal{B}|$. Our result provides an algorithmic counterpart to recent connectivity results for the reconfiguration graph of all independent transversals, and establishes polynomial bounds on its diameter under suitable conditions. As a specific application, we obtain a polynomial-time algorithm for reconfiguring perfect matchings in $r$-uniform bipartite hypergraphs $H=(A,B,E)$, that either produces a polynomial-length reconfiguration path between two given perfect matchings or identifies a subset $S\subseteq A$ whose link hypergraph $E_S$ in $B$ has a small cover.

AI.tldr: 本文针对带顶点划分的 $r$-claw-free 图，给出了独立横截（independent transversal）之间高效重配置的多项式时间算法，并应用于 $r$-一致二部超图的完美匹配重配置。
AI.motivation: 独立横截的重配置问题是组合数学与理论计算机科学中的核心问题，与 Haxell 关于独立横截存在性的经典结果以及重配置图的连通性猜想密切相关。此前关于独立横截重配置图连通性的结果多为存在性证明，缺乏高效算法，本文填补了这一算法空白。
AI.method: 论文结合了组合优化与图论技术，包括局部搜索、吸收方法（absorption method）的思想以及针对 $r$-claw-free 图的结构分析，设计多项式时间算法来构造重配置路径或识别障碍集。
AI.result: 对于任意固定的 $r\in\mathbb{N}$ 和 $\epsilon>0$，给定 $r$-claw-free 图 $G$ 的顶点划分 $\mathcal{V}=(V_1,\ldots,V_m)$ 及两个独立横截 $S$ 和 $R$，算法要么找到 $S$ 与 $R$ 之间多项式长度的重配置路径，要么找到一个非空划分类集合 $\mathcal{B}\subseteq\mathcal{V}$，使得其并集诱导的子图具有大小至多 $(2+\epsilon)|\mathcal{B}|$ 的强支配集。作为应用，对于 $r$-一致二部超图 $H=(A,B,E)$ 的完美匹配重配置，算法要么给出多项式长度的重配置路径，要么找到 $S\subseteq A$ 使得链接超图 $E_S$ 在 $B$ 中有小覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 该结果给出了独立横截重配置图连通性结果的算法对应，并在适当条件下建立了其直径的多项式上界，深化了对重配置问题计算复杂性的理解。
AI.future_work: 论文未明确列出开放问题，但自然延伸包括改进 $(2+\epsilon)$ 的界、处理更一般的图类（如非 $r$-claw-free 图）、以及探索其他组合结构的重配置算法。
